mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES mobility continues to rise from its recent trough, commuting-linked footfall will expand and push RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks because more workers pass through commercial areas on weekdays.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -42.0 to -32.0 over the last three weekly means while TRANSIT remained deeply negative.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains at or below its last-4-week mean despite a further weekly increase in WORKPLACES mobility.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL mobility stays elevated while PARKS mobility is also high, people substitute local outdoor and home-based activity for shopping trips, which depresses RETAIL_REC within one to two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stayed above baseline in all four weeks while PARKS spiked to 38.0 at t-1w.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days even though RESIDENTIAL remains above baseline and PARKS stays above baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A renewed downward step in TRANSIT after a brief stabilization will reduce access to central retail corridors and lower RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks through lost discretionary trips.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -35 after having been above -35 in the prior week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved only modestly from -40.9 to -34.3, remaining substantially below baseline.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall relative to the prior four-week mean after TRANSIT crosses below -35.

mechanism_narrative: A broad recovery in GROCERY_PHARM combined with WORKPLACES signals wider trip generation and nearby errand chaining, which should lift RETAIL_REC within one week as shopping is bundled with essential trips.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises above -5 while WORKPLACES rises week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved from -7.9 to -1.3 before easing to -2.4, while WORKPLACES rose from -42.0 to -32.0.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to increase in the next weekly mean after both GROCERY_PHARM and WORKPLACES meet the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS mobility jumps sharply above its recent level, it captures leisure time away from indoor retail and causes RETAIL_REC to weaken over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by more than 10 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose from 24.3 to 38.0 at t-1w before falling to 20.1 at t-0w.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline relative to the last four weeks after a >10-point weekly increase in PARKS.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT remains deeply depressed while RESIDENTIAL stays above baseline, shopping trips are being replaced by home-centered routines, so RETAIL_REC will stay below its recent average over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT is still around -34 to -41 while RESIDENTIAL is consistently positive.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC moves above its prior four-week mean even though TRANSIT stays below -30 and RESIDENTIAL stays above zero.

mechanism_narrative: In a loosening-regulation regime, a continued narrowing gap between WORKPLACES and TRANSIT indicates easier physical access to city-centre commerce, which should lift RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises for two consecutive weeks while TRANSIT improves by at least 3 points
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved week-to-week and TRANSIT also improved slightly from -40.9 to -34.3.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or declines over 28 days after both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT improve for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A short-lived rebound in GROCERY_PHARM followed by stabilization indicates normalized errand traffic rather than broader shopping recovery; unless WORKPLACES also improves, RETAIL_REC will not rise meaningfully over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM stays between -5 and 0 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved sharply to -1.3 at t-1w but WORKPLACES remained very weak near -32 to -42.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 14 days even though GROCERY_PHARM remains near baseline and WORKPLACES does not improve.
